title: Claude Code
system: Claude Code, through the Lathe plugin: its MCP server over stdio and its hooks
description: The Agent's MCP client and the plugin's host: the plugin's MCP tools write through the command layer, and its guard hook answers Claude Code's PreToolUse calls.

title: File manager
system: The operating system's file manager (Finder on macOS) and clipboard

title: Code editor
system: VS Code by default; Cursor, Zed, the system's default app or a command of the Owner's own

title: Git
description: The product folder's git repository: Git runs `lathe merge-data` for each data file `.gitattributes` names, and a record's history is read from it, never written.

title: System browser
description: Where a link to another site opens, outside the app.

title: Electron
system: The Electron runtime the desktop shell runs in
description: In development the watcher starts Electron on the shell's last build, and restarts it when the main process or a preload changes; a build that fails leaves it running.

title: electron-builder
system: electron-builder, which packs the desktop app
description: Packs the built shell and the staged Lathe package into an unsigned macOS app for this Mac's architecture in desktop/release/, which git ignores; it signs, notarizes and publishes nothing.
